ToD_A04_M13_VO_001.en: What is wrong? You seem to be on edge...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_001.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_002.en: I have faced many great enemies throughout my life, Zuluhed. Ogres, Arakkoa, and once even a Genesaur... none gave me pause... but whatever is waiting for us down there...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_002.speaker: Rend Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_003.en: There is no shame in fearing the unnatural, Rend. Steel yourself by remembering that we will face the horrors of this place together... whatever happens, you will not stand alone.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_003.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_004.en: Hmmm... These are orcish runes. No doubt Gul'dan means to use them to find his way out again.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_004.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_005.en: Interesting... he describes his arrival to the tomb...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_005.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_006.en: There is no telling what kind of power Gul'dan and his minions have awakened in this place. We should be careful.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_006.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_007.en: Agreed, few things can make orcs scream like that... this... this is wrong...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_007.speaker: Rend Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_008.en: Enough talk! The honorless scum must pay for this!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_008.speaker: Maim Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_009.en: This is a fragment of a staff, it radiates magical power... I will take it.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_009.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_010.en: Finally! The last piece of the Staff! The guardian's Artifact will serve us well.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_010.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_011.en: Brothers! The Servants of the Nether have returned!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_011.speaker: Fanatic

ToD_A04_M13_VO_012.en: Stand down, crazed dog! We are not Demons!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_012.speaker: Rend Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_013.en: Demon spawn! Your crusade will fail against the all-consuming void!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_013.speaker: Fanatic

ToD_A04_M13_VO_014.en: Ugh! I hate spiders, kill 'em fast!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_014.speaker: Maim Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_015.en: Those must be the spirits of the people who once inhabited these lands... they do indeed appear to be elves, fascinating! Be watchful... these restless spirits are vengeful.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_015.speaker: Zuluhed the Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_016.en: Ah, look brother, more spiders to fight!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_016.speaker: Rend Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_018.en: Ah... I gift fit for a queen.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_018.speaker: Faldorei Queen

ToD_A04_M13_VO_019.en: Wha..what is this thing!? Kill it! Kill it fast!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_019.speaker: Maim Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_020.en: Come, my children! Feast on their bones!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_020.speaker: Faldorei Queen

ToD_A04_M13_VO_021.en: Hgnh... my prize... it grows heavy..
ToD_A04_M13_VO_021.speaker: Faldorei Queen

ToD_A04_M13_VO_022.en: That was a tough fight... Maim? Are you alright big guy?
ToD_A04_M13_VO_022.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_024.en: Poor mangy dogs... this is what happens when you follow a crazed power-hungry warlock...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_024.speaker: Rend Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_025.en: More runes... these should help us find him!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_025.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_026.en: Again he mentioned this mysterious eye. What could it be?
ToD_A04_M13_VO_026.speaker: Rend Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_027.en: A powerful artifact... there is no doubt about that. It could be related to the fallen Titan’s power.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_027.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_028.en: Servants of the Warlock, kill them all!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_028.speaker: Rend Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_029.en: Oi, you there! If you share with us the treasures you found here, we'll fight for you!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_029.speaker: Pirate

ToD_A04_M13_VO_030.en: Aah the Seadogs, ever the opportunists! Very well, we can use reinforcements.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_030.speaker: Rend Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_031.en: Ah... a vision... a powerful guardian of this world... she defeated the fallen Titan...  split her staff when she locked the tomb!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_031.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_032.en: Turn back, you mortals! None may defile Tomb of Sargeras!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_032.speaker: Pit lord

ToD_A04_M13_VO_033.en: I can hear a voice beyond the gate... It's Gul'dan!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_033.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_034.en: Finally! At long last! I will claim my just reward!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_034.speaker: Gul'dan

ToD_A04_M13_VO_036.en: Who’s that?! Sargeras? Is that you?!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_036.speaker: Gul'dan

ToD_A04_M13_VO_037.en: Did Kil’jaeden's betrayal teach you nothing, little orc?
ToD_A04_M13_VO_037.speaker: Medivh

ToD_A04_M13_VO_038.en: You?! But I watched you die!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_038.speaker: Gul'dan

ToD_A04_M13_VO_039.en: Not that it matters... feel free to witness the moment of my greatest triumph, little magi, but stand in my way... and I will gladly return you to the jaws of death!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_039.speaker: Gul'dan

ToD_A04_M13_VO_040.en: Oh, foolish, pitiful creature... there is so much you do not know, so much you do not understand.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_040.speaker: Medivh

ToD_A04_M13_VO_041.en: Pitiful!? I will show you the meaning of...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_041.speaker: Gul'dan

ToD_A04_M13_VO_042.en: Treasonous filth! You have never been loyal to anyone but yourself. Your arrogance has blinded you, and has left yourself weak against those who truly tower above you!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_042.speaker: Orgrim Doomhammer

ToD_A04_M13_VO_044.en: Have you forgotten who you were, Gul’dan? Frail, weak and the dog of your clan. I have not forgotten, little Warlock, because it is all that you have ever been... weak!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_044.speaker: Gul'dan

ToD_A04_M13_VO_046.en: You delivered your people to the demons... only to end up humbled and humiliated!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_046.speaker: Ner'zhul

ToD_A04_M13_VO_047.en: In centuries past, I destroyed this foul avatar and sealed it in this eternal tomb to be forgotten by history... no being of this world could ever open it. Yet my victory was not complete...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_047.speaker: Aegwynn

ToD_A04_M13_VO_048.en: For when I felled him, his foul essence seeped into my soul... an unholy parasite gnawing ever so slowly, until he corrupted my womb and my child...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_048.speaker: Aegwynn

ToD_A04_M13_VO_050.en: We often wondered what became of Kil’jaeden’s little puppets... of Mannoroth’s favorite pets... and there you were, broken, confused and so pathetically desperate...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_050.speaker: Medivh

ToD_A04_M13_VO_051.en: I... I am... your humble servant, mighty Sargeras! Yes, I am here to break your chains... an agent not of this world... all shall know your glory! And together we will...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_051.speaker: Gul'dan

ToD_A04_M13_VO_052.en: Insolent worm! You dare swear fealty in the hour of your greatest failure?! I was freed the moment you entered this tomb, weakling, gaze now upon the might of doom unchained!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_052.speaker: Sargeras

ToD_A04_M13_VO_053.en: But Master! I beg of you! I have done all that you’ve asked!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_053.speaker: Gul'dan

ToD_A04_M13_VO_054.en: So spineless... so puny! Fuel to the flame you once controlled! May your cindered husk become a boon... to correct the course that you derailed!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_054.speaker: Sargeras

ToD_A04_M13_VO_055.en: No! I am Gul'dan! I am darkness incarnate... It cannot end... like this...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_055.speaker: Gul'dan

ToD_A04_M13_VO_056.en: The Warlock has been torn to shreds! And whoever killed him has caught the attention of every demon in this place! They’re coming!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_056.speaker: Rend Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_057.en: Our work here is finished! We must get out of here brother!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_057.speaker: Maim Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_058.en: Hold on! The Warchief commanded us to bring him Gul’dan’s head, otherwise he will not believe us!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_058.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_059.en: Feel free Zuluhed… grab it and let’s go!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_059.speaker: Rend Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_060.en: Dammit! Zuluhed! We can’t reach you! But I see a tunnel that might lead to the exit!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_060.speaker: Rend Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_061.en: Go with the Wind, Rend. I will find my own way to the surface!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_061.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_062.en: Very well... Zuluhed. Aka’magosh! See you on the surface!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_062.speaker: Rend Blackhand

ToD_A04_M13_VO_063.en: I am no match for these crazed demons! I must make my way to the surface at once!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_063.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_064.en: That was close, I think they lost my trail.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_064.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_066.en: Rakmar? Rakmar Sharpfang? I almost didn’t recognize you!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_066.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_067.en: I’m born anew, shaman! I now have more power than you could ever imagine. Praise be to Gul’dan’s gift!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_067.speaker: Rakmar Sharpfang

ToD_A04_M13_VO_068.en: Your master is no more, Death Knight! He was slaughtered by the very powers he had sworn to serve... I have his head right here!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_068.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_069.en: Such is the price of power! I will lead whatever’s left of the Stormreavers and find new glory!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_069.speaker: Rakmar Sharpfang

ToD_A04_M13_VO_070.en: Your allegiance belongs to the Horde. Submit to it or die where you stand!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_070.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked

ToD_A04_M13_VO_071.en: My allegiance is my own, Shaman! Come then... show me what you’ve got!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_071.speaker: Rakmar Sharpfang

ToD_A04_M13_VO_072.en: I... present my soul to the dark masters.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_072.speaker: Rakmar Sharpfang

ToD_A04_M13_VO_073.en: May this place crumble and return to the seas... forever.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_073.speaker: Zuluhed The Whacked
